title: Love the foods you hate
questions: What are the main ideas you learned from this episode? Please give a brief summary in your own words.
Why do our tastes change as we get older?
Is it worth training yourself to like a healthy food you dislike?
Can the way food is cooked completely change your opinion of it?
Have you ever learned to enjoy a food you once hated? What changed?
If a child refuses a certain food, should parents keep encouraging them to try it?
